in_marathi.name: Likhitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Daughter of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Likhitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Likhitha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Likhita' meaning 'written'. This name is believed to be given to a girl who is the embodiment of the Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. According to mythology, Lakshmi is often depicted as the one who writes down the good deeds of the devotees in her divine register. Therefore, the name Likhitha signifies being the 'daughter of God' or 'God's creation'.
